title: Quick Beef Pho with Rice Noodles and Herbs
summary: A fast Vietnamese-style beef pho with fragrant ginger, coriander, lime and tender steak over rice noodles. It is light but satisfying, perfect for a savoury dairy-free breakfast or brunch.

ingredients.name: beef-style broth made with vegetable stock

steps: Soak or cook the rice noodles according to the packet instructions until just tender, then drain and rinse briefly under warm water to stop them sticking.
Put the vegetable stock, ginger, garlic and half the sliced onion in a saucepan. Bring to a boil, then simmer for 12 minutes until fragrant.
Stir in the fish sauce, soy sauce, brown sugar, black pepper and salt. Taste the broth; it should be savoury, aromatic and lightly salty. Remove the ginger and garlic if you prefer a clearer bowl.
Divide the warm noodles between two deep bowls. Top with the thinly sliced raw beef steak and the remaining sliced onion.

Ladle the boiling-hot broth over the beef so it cooks in the bowl; the slices should turn from red to pale brown within 1 minute. If your slices are thicker, add them to the simmering broth for 30–60 seconds first.
Top with bean sprouts, spring onions, coriander, mint and chilli. Serve immediately with lime wedges for squeezing over.
